name: Accent Color Everywhere
description: Plasma-like accent color for the whole desktop: taken from the wallpaper, chosen freely or from GNOME Settings, and applied to GNOME Shell, GTK 3/4 (any theme, live), Qt/KDE apps, folder icons (mixed themes like Tela-dracula included), a focused-window outline, and optionally MangoHud, Wine and OpenRGB. Available in English and French.
